data.content_ref: inline:By gating reclamation strictly on visibility of an external seal ledger, the protocol cannot handle the stated scenario where the process crashed before writing that seal. An absent seal means the protocol must either reclaim and silently displace workspace-resident completed evidence, or refuse to reclaim and fail to function as a reclamation protocol. It thus delegates safety to a separate ledger that the crashed process may not have updated, violating the requirement to never silently displace evidence in the no-terminal-record case.
